name: legends
notes: Bake: node tools/legends/bake.mjs tools/legends/legends.config.json; check: node tools/legends/measure.mjs <out>/legends.json; re-solve knobs after editing likeness targets: node tools/legends/calibrate.mjs tools/legends/legends.config.json --write
height is BAREFOOT body height (listed heights are in shoes, about 2 cm more); macro.height auto keeps the uniform scale at 1.0 (LeBron saturates the slider, scale 1.0001).

Calibration knobs (solved by calibrate.mjs against meta.calibration, do not hand-edit): forehead/forehead-scale-vert, head/head-scale-vert, torso/measure-shoulder-dist, hands/hand-scale, feet/foot-scale, arms/measure-upperarm-length + measure-lowerarm-length, macro.weight.

Profile arm-length boosts were replaced by the wingspan knob: MakeHuman tall males already have wingspan/height of about 1.06, so the profile values overshot listed wingspans by up to 27 cm (Giannis 2.48 m, LeBron 2.37 m).

Profile head boosts (forehead-scale-vert, forehead-nubian, head-oval) made domed skulls (Jordan 7.4 heads tall, Giannis crown/face 1.35); forehead height is now solved for a crown->eye : eye->chin ratio of 0.98-1.05 and head-scale-vert for the head height.

Yao post-scale head 0.91 / neck 1.06 dropped: with macro.height auto the MakeHuman height targets already keep the head small (macro-only Yao head 24 cm = 9.4 heads); his head is calibrated to 26.5 cm (8.6 heads).
LeBron: stacked bulk targets roughly halved (estimated mass was 150 kg); stomach/stomach-tone-decr-incr DOES exist (the profile said it did not) and is used.
Giannis: forehead-nubian and head-oval dropped, chin-height 0.85; his macro skull is domed so craniumFace target is 1.05 and the head knobs sit at +/-1 (head 23.2 cm, 9.0 heads tall).
Yao: torso-scale-horiz 0.4 and measure-bust-circ 0.2 added (his chest was the narrowest of the six).
Zero-valued profile modifiers were omitted; measure-* modifiers are unsided; asym-* modifiers are unsided bipolar (+ = the -r target).

meta.stats.standingReachM for Jordan set to 2.65 (profile estimate 2.67) to match Kobe (same height and wingspan); every model no-shrug overhead reach is 22-27 cm under the listed reach, i.e. the six reach figures are mutually consistent.
v2 (SPEC-v2 §10.3 round 1): likeness modifiers changed as listed in SPEC-v2 §10.3, then calibrate.mjs --write re-solved the calibration knobs.
expressions: the 9 channels of SPEC-v2 §3.9 per player ({modifiers, jaw {rotDeg, translate}, tongue {translate}, lids}); baked as sparse morph deltas by lib/morphs.mjs.
appearance: bake-time grooming geometry (hair hairline/layers, beard components/layers, eyebrows) per SPEC-v2 §2.8, plus the runtime look (§2.6) and kit data (§2.7) passed through to the header.
meta.stats keys match src/legends.js (heightM, barefootM, weightKg, wingspanM, reachM); unit-lineup.mjs compares them with the header.

meta.calibration.headH / craniumFace use the v2 measure.mjs menton = the frozen ME landmark (crown -> ME). The PoC heuristic picked the lips or the nose tip as pogonion whenever they protruded, so its values (24.0 ... 26.4 cm) were not anatomical. Each target = the v1 bake re-measured with the ME landmark + the SPEC-v2 §10.3 delta (Kobe craniumFace -0.03; Giannis headH -0.004 m, craniumFace +0.05); the §10.2 face bands were derived from those same v1 faces.

hair.hairline.aboveCm is the forehead height measured up the forehead midline surface from the glabella (bake converts it per player to a height); as a vertical offset 6-7.5 cm left only 2-3 cm of scalp in front of the vertex on these heads.

Hairline: a temporal line (WP1 addition) descends from the temple corner (phiC - 0.35 rad) to ET.y + earGap at the sideburn front; without it the temples were bare up to Gy + 5-6 cm (flat-cap look in 3/4 and profile).

Ear exclusion for grooming/masks uses the refined ear set (box vertices protruding past |x| 0.074 plus their side-view hull); the SPEC box set (|x| > 0.071) also caught the skull above the ear. The earOut metric keeps the box set.
Landmark SN is base.obj vertex 343 (the midline vertex at the quoted coordinates); the quoted 342 is 1.4 mm right of the midline.

Lip seam: 36 vertices shared by upper- and lower-lip faces are split into coincident upper/lower copies so jawOpen/roar open the mouth onto the teeth instead of stretching the lip contact into a curtain.
